d:
Dirk Nowitzki delivered a LEGENDARY performance in the EuroBasket 2005 semifinals!
Germany and Spain went toe-to-toe in an incredible battle for a spot in the FINAL, with both teams fighting until the very last seconds.
With just 14 seconds left, Juan Carlos Navarro gave Spain a 73-72 lead. But Dirk had other plans!
Nowitzki hit a clutch baseline jumper with just 3.9 seconds remaining to put Germany ahead 74-73 and seal one of the most dramatic victories in EuroBasket history!
